sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: This repository holds Anthropic's own plugins for Claude and the claude-plugins-official marketplace for Claude Code. Plugins add commands, agents, skills, hooks and MCP servers to Claude Code.
sixtySeconds.problem: Finding trustworthy Claude Code plugins is hard. This is Anthropic's official home for its own plugins, installable straight from Claude Code's plugin system.
whoFor: Teams standardising their Claude Code setup
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for plugins maintained by Anthropic, installed with one command from inside Claude Code.

overview: Install a plugin with /plugin install followed by the plugin name and @claude-plugins-official, or browse in /plugin > Discover.

The plugins folder holds plugins built by Anthropic; external_plugins holds third-party plugins added before submissions moved to claude.ai/directory/manage, plus Anthropic's channel plugins. The marketplace file is being reduced over time to Anthropic's own plugins.
The README warns that Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files or software third-party plugins include, so trust a plugin before installing it. The repository is Apache-2.0 licensed.
